title: Acquire and verify an installation candidate
description: Admit a supported install-only request and obtain a safely staged archive whose identity matches compatible package-bundled trusted metadata. Local archive input changes acquisition, not the trust root.
inputs: Requested target, version selection, supported options, and trusted official or explicit local archive source.
Package-bundled artifact metadata and its release index.
outputs: Verified staged candidate with target, release, permitted roots, inventory, and integrity basis.
Explicit unsupported-request, missing-metadata, acquisition, archive-integrity, or extraction failure.
behavior: Reject missing/unknown/retired targets and removed state-writing or adapter syntax before acquisition, extraction, or writes.
Verify compatible bundled metadata against its release index before trusting archive identity.
Acquire only the selected trusted official resource or explicitly supplied archive, and verify filename, target, release, digest, and size before extraction.
Reject unsafe paths, unsupported links, and out-of-root members; keep the permitted package support entrypoint outside installed scope.
Verify candidate tree identities and counts under the supported current or historical representation without reading unrelated project state.

failure_behavior.condition: The request selects retired or unsupported behavior, even through a pinned or local archive.
failure_behavior.outcome: Reject before side effects and identify the supported form.

failure_behavior.condition: Compatible bundled metadata or archive integrity cannot be established.
failure_behavior.outcome: Stop without accepting supplied metadata as an alternative trust root.

failure_behavior.condition: An archive member violates containment or declared inventory.
failure_behavior.outcome: Reject the candidate before any installed-unit mutation.
